nodes.label: Responsible API Study Practices
nodes.rationale: API-based studies should budget costs, respect provider terms and rate limits, minimize sensitive data, and report model/version and sampling parameters to ensure ethical and reproducible experimentation.

nodes.label: Dry-run Provider
nodes.rationale: Follows the same storage and evaluation path as real providers without making network calls, enabling pipeline testing and dry runs without API cost or provider dependency.

nodes.label: LLMClient Interface
nodes.rationale: Real providers should implement LLMClient and read credentials from the environment, decoupling provider swapping from pipeline logic and keeping secrets out of config files.

nodes.label: Academic Reproducibility Practices
nodes.rationale: For academic reproducibility, retain configuration files, seeds, dataset version/hash, provider/model parameters, timestamps, and raw responses so results can be independently verified and re-derived.

nodes.label: Resumable Request ID Scheme
nodes.rationale: Request IDs are UUID5 values derived from run, model, and question IDs so duplicate records are skipped, making interrupted runs resumable without re-querying providers.
